title: The investor emotion cycle
objectives: Name the five cycle phases, what investors do in each, and what we do.
Say where most investors buy and where most sell.
body_md:
Every market cycle pulls investors to buy near the top and sell near the bottom; our job is to move clients against their own emotions, calmly and without promises. Rising market: optimism → excitement; investors add money and take more risk; we stick to target allocation. Peak: euphoria; investors pile in and chase hot funds; we rebalance and warn against FOMO. Falling market: anxiety → fear; investors check daily and question the plan; we call proactively and reconnect to goals. Bottom: panic → despondency; investors stop SIPs and redeem; we keep SIPs going and deploy planned STP money. Recovery: hope → optimism; investors wait on the sidelines “until it's clear”; we show what staying invested achieved.

| Phase | What investors feel | What they tend to do | What we do |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Rising market | Optimism → excitement | Add money, take more risk | Stick to target allocation |
| Peak | Euphoria | Pile in; chase hot funds | Rebalance; warn against FOMO |
| Falling market | Anxiety → fear | Check daily; question the plan | Call proactively; reconnect to goals |
| Bottom | Panic → despondency | Stop SIPs; redeem | Keep SIPs going; deploy planned STP money |
| Recovery | Hope → optimism | Wait on the sidelines "until it's clear" | Show what staying invested achieved |

> **Investor takeaway:** Market falls are normal. Staying invested through them is how long-term returns are earned.
example: Peak euphoria: clients pile into hot funds — rebalance and warn against FOMO. Bottom despondency: clients stop SIPs — keep them going, deploy planned STP money.
say: Buy near the top and sell near the bottom is the cycle to break.
At the bottom, keep SIPs going; deploy planned STP money.
never: Buy at the bottom and sell at the peak is what most investors do naturally.
At the peak, add more risk.

check.q: At which point in the emotion cycle do most investors buy?
check.why: Euphoria. They buy near the peak, when risk is highest.

check.q: At which point in the emotion cycle do most investors sell?
o: Near the bottom, in panic or despondency
check.why: At which point do most investors sell? Near the bottom, in panic or despondency.

check.q: In the falling-market phase, what should we do?
o: Call proactively and reconnect to goals
check.why: Falling market: anxiety → fear; investors check daily; we call proactively and reconnect to goals.
